title: Integrability of split tangent bundles on rationally connected manifolds
summary: We prove that both summands of every specified holomorphic splitting of the tangent bundle of a smooth rationally connected projective complex manifold into two positive-rank subbundles are integrable. This proves Höring's conjecture on rationally connected projective manifolds. Höring's product theorem then gives a product decomposition compatible with the specified splitting.

review.reason: Proves integrability of tangent bundle splittings on rationally connected manifolds, settling a conjecture.
